title: Back End Developer
description:
Senior PHP Backend Engineer (Laravel / Symfony)


US Hours | High-Impact Platform | Excellent Compensation


We’re partnering with a long-standing US client to hire a Senior PHP Backend Engineer to help build and scale a mission-critical enterprise platform used by real users every day.


This is not a CMS or agency role.


This is a backend ownership role focused on payments, workflows, reporting, and scalable services.

If you’ve built and supported production PHP systems with real databases and real transactions, this role is worth your time.

What You’ll Be Working On

As a senior member of the engineering team, you’ll help design, build, and stabilize core backend services that power:

  • Payment processing and transactional workflows
  • Authentication and secure access services
  • Reporting and document generation systems
  • Internal and public-facing REST APIs
  • Business process automation engines
  • You’ll collaborate closely with product, DevOps, and QA teams while helping shape technical standards and improving system reliability and performance.
What This Role Actually Requires

We’re looking for engineers who have owned systems, not just tickets.

You should have:

  • 5+ years of professional PHP development experience
  • Strong experience with Laravel or Symfony in production
  • Deep understanding of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server)
  • Experience building or supporting transactional systems (payments, billing, financial workflows, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and backend services
  • Comfort troubleshooting live production issues
  • Experience deploying or supporting applications in AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Ability to work US hours and collaborate with a US-based team
Big Plus (Not Required)
  • Payment gateway integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.net, etc.)
  • SaaS or multi-tenant platforms
  • Workflow engines or reporting systems
  • Security-focused backend work
  • Mentoring or code review leadership
  • Senior-level ownership and real technical impact
  • Excellent compensation, benefits, and long-term growth potential
  • Fast interview process (1–2 rounds max)
  • Work on systems that matter—not throwaway projects
  • A team that values clean architecture, reliability, and execution

If you’ve owned production PHP systems and enjoy solving real backend problems at scale, let’s talk. Message me directly or apply here to start the conversation. Also feel free to send your resume to

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) PL
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Mid‑Level Software Developer (Product Team) — Azure AKS

Job Location: REMOTE - Nearshore


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of: .NET/C#, Java, or Node.js for building RESTful services.

title: Designer gráfico freelancer
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional para integrar nosso time, atuando em iniciativas criativas e de inovação, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções de design que apoiem objetivos de negócio e comunicação em diferentes canais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você será responsável por:

  • Criar e entregar materiais de design para apoiar iniciativas de marketing, comunicação e produtos digitais
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para compreender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções visuais
  • Garantir consistência com diretrizes de marca, padrões visuais e sistemas de design
  • Gerenciar múltiplas demandas de design, assegurando qualidade e cumprimento de prazos
  • Manter documentação relacionada a processos, padrões e componentes de design
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, revisões e rituais do time
  • Comunicar status, riscos e dependências para as partes interessadas

Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição é importante que você tenha:

  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a design
  • Sólidos fundamentos de design visual (tipografia, cor, composição e layout)
  • Experiência com entregáveis digitais e/ou de marketing
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes colaborativos e ágeis
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Organização e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas prioridades
  • Inglês avançado


Seria legal se você tivesse:

  • Experiência com sistemas de design ou diretrizes de marca
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas modernas de design e colaboração
  • Vivência em times globais ou multidisciplinares

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SDR Pleno/Sênior – HarmonizaPRO


APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COMO SDR E RESULTADOS COMPROVADOS


Esse cargo exige alta energia, ambição, excelente oratória, organização e disciplina para seguir processos. Não buscamos alguém que \"quer aprender a ser SDR\", buscamos alguém que já domina a função e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance.


Sobre a vaga:

Você será responsável por qualificar leads inbound (vindos de tráfego pago e indicações) e acompanhá-los até o comparecimento na call com o closer. Também terá uma carteira de clientes para reativação, garantindo uma agenda sempre cheia.

Seu papel é fundamental: você é a primeira impressão da HarmonizaPRO para o cliente. Precisa identificar oportunidade, gerar conexão e conduzir o lead com maestria até a próxima etapa.


Responsabilidades:

  • Qualificação de leads via ligação (boa parte do processo é por telefone)
  • Acompanhamento e follow-up até o comparecimento em call
  • Reativação de base de clientes
  • Atualização rigorosa do CRM
  • Participação em dailys, 1:1s com gestor e weeklys


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO:

Somos a maior aceleradora comercial para clínicas de harmonização facial do Brasil. Fundamos a empresa em 2021 e saímos de 2 founders para 43 pessoas, com sede em Balneário Camboriú. Nosso objetivo é ser o maior ecossistema de marketing e vendas para clínicas do mundo.


Remuneração:

  • Salário fixo inicial: R$ 3.000, com aumento de $500 após 3 meses de metas batidas, chegando num teto de R$5.000 de fixo.
  • Variável agressivo baseado em performance
  • Média salarial inicial: R$ 6.000 a R$ 10.000/mês
  • Potendo chegar até R$ 12.000+/mês para quem entrega resultado acima da média


Detalhes da vaga:

  • Local: Remoto (com oportunidade e preferência para migração ao presencial em Balneário Camboriú — a ser discutido na fase de contratação)
  • Regime: PJ
  • Horário: Integral
  • Ferramentas: CRM, Meet, WhatsApp, planilhas e plataformas de gestão comercial


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Experiência comprovada como SDR (com métricas para mostrar)
  • Excelente oratória e comunicação por telefone
  • Energia e ambição
  • Organização e disciplina para seguir processos
  • Capacidade de lidar com volume e manter qualidade
  • Receptividade a feedbacks e melhoria contínua

title: Especialista de Desenvolvimento Powerbuilder
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações Powerbuilder;
  • Desenvolvimento de Scripts SQL e ORACLE;
  • Desenvolvimento de Projetos utilizando metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações Powerbuilder;

Experiência com desenvolvimento de Scripts SQL e ORACLE;

Experiência com desenvolvimento de Projetos utilizando metodologias ágeis.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Código da oportunidade: 56985

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java, Springboot, mensageria, conceitos de devops, esteira CI/CD, terraform e AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Accounting Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM)

Salary Range: $1,800 – $2,500 USD/month,


Role Overview

We’re looking for a proactive and detail-driven Controller to lead accounting operations across our client base. At our company we serve some of the most exciting names in tech and fintech, and your role will be key to making sure the numbers stay clean, clear, and compliant. If you love QuickBooks, live for clean reconciliations, and thrive in remote environments — let’s talk!


✅ Key responsabilities

Own full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks (AR, AP, reconciliations, billing, etc.).

Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records.

Collaborate with our Head of Accounting Ops to prepare financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).

Maintain compliance with accounting standards and best practices.

Support month-end and year-end closing processes.


Requirements

3+ years of hands-on finance-accounting experience.

Expert in QuickBooks and familiar with other accounting tools.

Solid understanding of accounting principles and workflows.

Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Excellent communicator and team player.

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup.

Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.


Nice to have

CPA certification.

Previous experience in client-facing or startup environments.

Tech-savvy and confident navigating remote collaboration tools.

title: Analista de Suporte e Monitoramento
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Suporte para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, multicultural e com foco em excelência no atendimento ao usuário. A posição terá papel fundamental no suporte técnico, gestão de incidentes e solicitações, além de apoiar na documentação e monitoramento de processos e projetos.


Informações da vaga

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Home Office;
  • Horário: 04h00 às 12h00.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto focal para que usuários relatem problemas e solicitações;
  • Gerenciar incidentes e solicitações de serviço, garantindo acompanhamento e resolução adequada;
  • Fornecer resolução de chamados no primeiro contato, com base em instruções e procedimentos de trabalho;
  • Monitorar atividades e apoiar na redação de documentações de projetos, como descrição de tarefas, casos de uso e instruções operacionais;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão para registro, acompanhamento e controle dos chamados.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão de chamados, como ServiceNow, Jira, Service Manager ou CISM.


Idiomas

  • Inglês e Alemão em nível avançado.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: UI Designer & Design Ops
description:
Modalidade: Presencial – Brasília

Regime: CLT

Carga horária: Segunda à quinta - 8h às 18h / Sexta - 8h às 17h


Estamos em busca de um(a) especialista em Interface e Design Sytem que respire Figma. Se você é aquela pessoa que organiza camadas por instinto, domina variáveis e cria protótipos de alta fidelidade que parecem um produto real, seu lugar e aqui. ❤️


O foco desta função não é Discovery (embora você possa vir ajudar com isso), mas sim a execução técnica de alto nível, garantindo que nossas entregas sejam rápidas, consistentes e prontas para o hand-off de engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

Gestão do Design System: Ser o(a) guardião(ã) da biblioteca da Ticket and Go, evoluindo componentes, tokens e documentação para garantir escalabilidade.

Prototipagem de alta performace: Criar fluxos interativos complexos com velocidade, utilizando recursos avançados do Figma para simular a experiênvia final

Refinamento de UI: Transformar conceitos e wireframes em interfaces pixel-perfect, com foco total em estética, hierarquia visual e padrões de interação.

Hand-off técnico: Colaborar diretamente com desenvolvedores para garantir que a implementação seja fiel ao design, resolvendo dúvidas sobre comportamentos de componentes e auto-layout.

Consistência Cross-Product: Garantir que toda nova funcionalidade siga rigorosamente os padrões visuais estabelecidos, evitando o \"débito técnico\" de design.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de orientar equipes.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Golang Developer - Relocation to Spain
description:
At CAPITOLE, we keep growing and want to do it with you!


We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.


The position is fully remote, but you must be based in Spain, with willingness to relocate to Barcelona or Madrid. We take care of processing the highly qualified work permit.


What profile are we looking for?

  • University degree or, equivalently, 5 years of professional experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in backend development with Golang and a minimum of 2 years of experience in PHP/Symfony, Java/Kotlin or Python.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Desde 2005, fazemos parceria com algumas das maiores entidades dos setores de saúde, ciências da vida, serviços financeiros e governo em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade empolgante para um(a) Líder de Engenharia de Software altamente qualificado(a) se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica.


Tipo de Contrato : Tempo Integral

Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços


Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Analista de Portfólio de Projetos - Sênior
description:
Com mais de 40 anos de história, somos pioneiros e especialistas no segmento de empréstimos consignados. E também, em investimentos de renda fixa e variável com o Paraná Banco Investimentos.

Oferecemos empréstimos com segurança e transparência para quem deseja quitar dívidas maiores, investir em algo ou realizar um sonho. Com o propósito transformar soluções financeiras em sorrisos!


E o que nos torna especiais?

  • Somos apaixonados pelo sorriso: Buscamos as melhores experiências para os nossos clientes, valorizamos as pessoas e somos apaixonados pela empresa.
  • Somos inovadores e buscamos simplicidade: Testamos, aprendemos e pensamos sempre em melhorias contínuas.
  • Somos flexíveis e promovemos mudanças: Cultivamos a adaptabilidade como virtude, incentivando e promovendo constantes transformações para alcançar o melhor de cada jornada.
  • Somos guiados por dados: Os nossos objetivos são claros, se não podemos medir, não podemos fazer. Somos direcionados pela eficiência e aproveitamos ao máximo os recursos disponíveis.


Nossas vagas são destinadas à todas as pessoas! Sem distinção de gênero, raça, cor, idade, orientação sexual ou etnia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar o andamento das ações do portfólio afim de ter as informações mais corretas e assertivas de cada iniciativa cadastrada;
  • Avaliar riscos de execução e negócio dos projetos;
  • Construir apresentações executivas e estratégicas que demonstrem o status do portfólio;
  • Analise critica de relatórios e implementação de melhoria continua no acompanhamento de projetos;
  • Desenvolver e implementar frameworks de governança para monitorar o progresso das iniciativas;
  • Garantir a conformidade com a governança e processos internos;
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade e impacto financeiro das iniciativas;
  • Facilitar workshops e reuniões para promover o entendimento e a colaboração entre as partes interessadas;
  • Promover a capacitação das equipes em metodologias de gestão de valor e praticar as ações e etapas padrões da governança.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos e programas, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos bancários ou afins;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e experiência em gestão de portfólio ao menos 2 anos;
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Conhecimento e destreza no Calculo de WSJF.


Modelo de trabalho:

Presencial: Para equipes de Call Center, com jornada integral no escritório.

Híbrido : Trabalho remoto combinado com presença obrigatória no escritório às terças, quartas e quintas-feiras.

Remoto: Trabalho integralmente remoto, podendo haver viagens ocasionais para a sede em Curitiba/PR.


O que temos para você:

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição (Sem descontos!)

title: Backend Developer
description:
The professional will work primarily in the Conversion Squad, responsible for lead acquisition flows and marketing forms — a high‑impact and business‑critical area at Creditas.

The main focus will be Back-end development using Kotlin + Spring Boot + Node.


Responsibilities


  • Develop Back-end solutions ensuring functionality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Build services aligned with business strategy, OKRs, and product initiatives.
  • Implement and maintain reliable and scalable microservices and REST APIs.
  • Create automated tests following the testing pyramid.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with pair programming and a strong feedback culture.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in daily meetings, agile ceremonies, and when raising blockers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement within the Conversion Squad projects.



Competencies


  • Strong and active communication — especially during daily meetings.
  • Proactive attitude in raising issues, proposing solutions, and seeking support when needed.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering).
  • Organization and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.
  • Hard Skills — Mandatory (Must Have):
  • Proficiency in Kotlin, Node and Spring Boot (top priority).
  • Solid experience with microservices and REST API architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases.
  • Experience with automated testing and understanding of the testing pyramid.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).


Nice to Have:


  • Experience with modern Front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js).
  • Experience with messaging tools (Kafka, AWS SQS, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Clean Code and Design Patterns.


Skill Set


  • Kotlin + Spring Boot + Node
  • Microservices & Distributed Architecture
  • REST APIs
  • Relational Databases
  • Automated Testing

title: Java Full stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Fullstack Java Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Solid experience in Java 8+ and frameworks such as Spring/Spring Boot.

Technical knowledge of Java 7 or 8, JSP - Java Server Pages, JSF - Java Server Faces, JBOSS, Primefaces, and Wildfly.

Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).

Experience in front-end development with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.

Experience with REST APIs, authentication, and authorization (OAuth2, JWT).

Knowledge of version control tools (Git) and continuous integration pipelines.

Experience with microservices architecture and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

Proficiency in automated testing (JUnit, Mockito, Cypress, Jest).

Familiarity with Docker environments and orchestration (Kubernetes).


Desirable skills:

Experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Knowledge of serverless architecture and Lambda functions

Java or Cloud certifications

Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)


Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, and maintain applications using Java on the back end and modern front-end frameworks (Angular, React, or Vue.js).

Design and implement RESTful APIs and system integrations.

Ensure best practices in software architecture, security, and performance.

Collaborate with product, design, and QA teams to deliver high-value solutions.

Perform code reviews and mentor less experienced developers.

Participate in technical decisions and help define standards and best practices.

Automate build, testing, and deployment processes (CI/CD).

Monitor and provide support for applications in production.


Java 7, 8 and 8+,, JSP - Java Server Pages, JSF - Java Server Faces , JBOSS, Primefaces, Wildfly, Spring/SpringBoot

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Sênior para atuar na manutenção, evolução e desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos, participando ativamente das definições de arquitetura e dos processos de desenvolvimento. O(a) profissional irá trabalhar em ambientes complexos, com forte integração entre sistemas, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software e metodologias ágeis.


Responsabilidades


  • Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva, além da codificação de sistemas.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e definições de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar no uso de metodologias de desenvolvimento de sistemas e na especificação funcional.
  • Realizar modelagem e mapeamento de processos.
  • Conduzir levantamentos de dados complementares (negócios, integrações e técnicos).
  • Desenvolver e executar testes unitários e integrados.
  • Criar e manter Queries, Stored Procedures, Triggers, Functions e Views.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do SCRUM (planning, dailies, reviews e retrospectives).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com Java 1.8 ou superior, incluindo:
  • EJB, Servlet, JDBC, Swing e WebServices.
  • Experiência com frameworks:
  • Hibernate, Spring, Struts, Aspose, Jasper, Oracle Toplink e Quartz.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL (Microsoft SSIS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados:
  • SQL Server, DB2 e Oracle.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com UML.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento:
  • Eclipse, Maven, Ant e SVN.
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.



Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com .NET.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle PL/SQL.
  • Vivência com WebSphere.
  • Conhecimentos ou práticas em DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Cursos técnicos ou de especialização na área.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento no segmento de seguros.
  • Certificações técnicas.
  • Conhecimento em Espanhol.

title: Crypto Market Maker
description:
Crypto Market Maker Company: Meta Martian Location: Brazil (Remote) Department: Algorithmic Trading and Liquidity

Compensation Strategy

Salary Range: $100,000 – $140,000 USD per year plus Performance Bonus We pay in USD or USDC. This base salary is benchmarked significantly above the local Brazilian market rate for quantitative finance roles. We expect world-class execution and we pay accordingly.

The Mission and Market Function

At Meta Martian , we provide the liquidity that keeps the crypto economy moving. We are seeking a Crypto Market Maker to manage our proprietary trading strategies on both Centralized (CEX) and Decentralized (DEX) exchanges. Your mission is not to predict the future price of Bitcoin. Your mission is to ensure that our order books are deep, our spreads are tight, and our inventory is balanced. You are the architect of market efficiency.

The Scope of Execution

Your primary mandate is the management of our automated trading systems. You will oversee a portfolio of market-making algorithms that quote bid and ask orders 24 hours a day. You must constantly adjust the parameters of these bots based on market volatility. When the market is calm, you capture the spread. When the market crashes, you manage the risk to ensure we do not end up holding \"toxic flow.\" You are responsible for the daily Profit and Loss (PnL) of your assigned pairs.

Operational Responsibility and Tooling

This role requires a hybrid of trading intuition and engineering skill. You will spend your day in Python . You will write scripts to analyze trade history and optimize our quoting logic. You will connect to Exchange APIs via WebSocket to monitor latency and order rejection rates. You will work closely with our quant developers to improve our execution infrastructure, but you must be capable of fixing a broken script yourself in the middle of the night if necessary.

Negative Scope

To ensure we are aligned, please note the following:

  • Not a Discretionary Trader: You will not be manually buying or selling assets based on technical analysis patterns or news sentiment. You manage systems, not individual trades.
  • Not a Blockchain Developer: You do not need to write Smart Contracts in Solidity. You need to understand market microstructure and exchange connectivity.
  • Not an Entry-Level Role: We cannot train you on the basics of an Order Book or how an AMM works. You must arrive with this knowledge fully formed.
The Trader Archetype

We are looking for a candidate with a background in Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science . You have professional experience in high-frequency trading (HFT) or electronic market making, either in crypto or traditional finance (B3/BM&F). You are comfortable handling large notional values and stay calm when volatility spikes. You understand that in market making, risk management is more important than profit maximization.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix

  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil’s cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20–30% of the time)

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior IA Generativa
description:
Cientista de Dados Sênior IA Generativa


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:


Atuar como referência técnica na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial Generativa para resolver desafios de negócio, desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras e escaláveis. Contribuir para a estruturação da fundação de IA na empresa, participando desde a concepção até a implementação de POCs e integrações.


  • Entender demandas das áreas de negócio (jurídico, marketing, etc.) e propor soluções baseadas em IA.
  • Desenvolver protótipos e POCs utilizando ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Integrar APIs e serviços de IA em sistemas internos, garantindo segurança e governança.
  • Avaliar e recomendar ferramentas, frameworks e arquiteturas para ampliar a capacidade da área.
  • Contribuir para definição da stack tecnológica e boas práticas da fundação de IA.
  • Garantir versionamento e documentação dos projetos.
  • Atuar com autonomia e visão crítica para sugerir melhorias e novas abordagens.


Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:


Requisitos essenciais:

  • Experiência sólida em Python (desenvolvimento de software, ML ou engenharia de dados).
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning , Deep Learning e conceitos de IA generativa.
  • Familiaridade com engenharia de prompt e frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Low Code aplicadas a IA.
  • Compreensão de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .
  • Vivência em cloud computing (preferencialmente AWS; experiência com Azure ou GCP é aceitável).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL).
  • Controle de versão com Git .
  • Desejável experiência com integração de APIs e boas práticas de segurança.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com projetos de IA generativa.
  • Certificações em cloud ou IA.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e governança de modelos.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
